primary_source.title: Bound States in Lee's Complex Ghost Model
primary_source.author: Ichiro Oda

source_relations.stationary_threshold: omega^*_{p-k}+omega_k = 2 Re omega_k >= 2 Re M at p_vec=0
source_relations.source_conclusion: positive-norm bound-state formation does not imply permanent confinement of the massive ghost; the massive-ghost problem in higher-derivative gravity remains unresolved

prescription_caveat: source explicitly notes the result might change if the 2025 amplitude-prescription contour is used instead of the Lee-Wick contour

authority_conflict.Donoghue_Menezes_2019: claims all-orders unitarity with only stable-state cuts for unstable ghost resonance
authority_conflict.Kubo_Kugo_2023: operator formalism claims complex ghosts are created and physical unitarity is violated above a definite threshold
authority_conflict.Oda_2026: uses the Kubo-Kugo canonical formalism; finds a positive-norm bound-state possibility below threshold but states this is not permanent confinement and does not solve the massive-ghost problem
